notes: Dev TBox revision. The rule is the defining anatomical fact about sharks and has no real exception, so the original answers are right. The derived questions name rare real sharks by scientific name (a lanternshark, the Pondicherry shark, the pocket shark) and state the membership in the prompt, so the class rule is the only route (inheritance, 2 hops). The third is an application (choosing a cleaning method for the skeleton's tissue) that names no candidate tissue, so there is no 50% floor. Unrelated near: what sharks breathe with (gills). The edit contradicts the stored 'sharks are cartilaginous fish' plus 'cartilaginous fish have cartilage skeletons', so a consistent model must drop one of them; either way the answer for a shark is bone, since the edit is a rule about sharks themselves, so the three derived queries stay determinate.
